title: Lamb Tagine with Eastern Flair
description: A hearty and aromatic lamb tagine that's perfect for a cold winter's night. This traditional Moroccan dish is infused with the rich flavors of the luscious eastern spices.

ingredients.name: middle eastern spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and turmeric

ingredients.name: luscious eastern spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of cayenne pepper, paprika, and allspice

instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per batch.
Transfer the browned lamb to a plate and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add more oil if needed.
Cook the onion and garlic until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the middle eastern spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb back to the pot, along with the chicken broth, apricots, and almonds.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the luscious eastern spices and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
